mapper.select: select (select count(1) from edu_resource where del_flag = '0') as resourceCount, (select count(1) from edu_course where del_flag = '0') as courseCount, (select count(1) from edu_category where del_flag = '0') as categoryCount, (select count(1) from edu_tag where del_flag = '0') as tagCount, (select count(1) from edu_resource where audit_status = 'pending' and del_flag = '0') as pendingAuditCount, (select count(1) from edu_comment where del_flag = '0') as commentCount, (select count(1) from edu_report where status = 'pending' and del_flag = '0') as pendingReportCount, (select count(1) from edu_favorite) as favoriteCount, (select count(1) from edu_download_log) as downloadCount, (select count(1) from sys_feedback where del_flag = '0') as feedbackCount, ( select count(1) from ( select user_id from edu_download_log where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) union select user_id from edu_favorite where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) union select user_id from edu_comment where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) union select uploader_id as user_id from edu_resource where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) ) t ) as activeUserCount, ( select ifnull(round( (sum(case when audit_status = 'approved' then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(1), 0)) * 100, 2 ), 0) from edu_resource_audit ) as auditPassRate, ( select ifnull(round( (sum(case when status <> 'pending' then 1 else 0 end) / nullif(count(1), 0)) * 100, 2 ), 0) from edu_report where del_flag = '0' ) as reportHandleRate
select resource_title as name, ifnull(download_count, 0) as value from edu_resource where del_flag = '0' order by ifnull(download_count, 0) desc, resource_id desc limit 10
select uploader_name as name, count(1) as value from edu_resource where del_flag = '0' group by uploader_name order by count(1) desc, uploader_name asc limit 10

select x.user_name as name, sum(x.score) as value from ( select user_name, count(1) * 3 as score from edu_download_log where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by user_name union all select user_name, count(1) * 2 as score from edu_comment where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by user_name union all select user_name, count(1) as score from edu_favorite where create_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 30 day) group by user_name ) x where ifnull(x.user_name, '') <> '' group by x.user_name order by value desc, x.user_name asc limit 10
select category_name as name, count(1) as value from edu_resource where del_flag = '0' group by category_name order by count(1) desc, category_name asc

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, count(1) as value from edu_resource where del_flag = '0' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by day asc

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as day, count(1) as value from edu_download_log where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by day asc
